## Privacy and security checklist

- [ ] No real customer names, site names, site/postcode codes or employee identifiers

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, unredacted request/response logs or production configuration
- [ ] Screenshots, test fixtures, commit messages and **removed diff lines** checked
- [ ] CI Gitleaks scan reviewed; potential exposures handled privately
